name: Joseph
review: Our work crew stayed at this home and it was 100% much better than any hotel.  Very nice and very close to our work area.

name: Eric
review: Anna was very responsive to questions. The house is on a channel in clear lake and was fun to fish from the docks.

name: Michelle
review: Loved every minute of our stay. The neighbors were friendly and it was so peaceful. We loved having the private dock.

name: Francesco
review: I would not hesitate to book again

name: Carlos
review:
This is a perfect place to spend a week with the family. I regret not bringing a boat, the house has a dock with access to the beautiful lake, plenty of fish.
We went for a walk to the small town of Clearlake and spent a good 1/2 hour at a park with beach. People were fishing at the beach and pulling 10 pound catfish. Amazing.
The house is a perfect place to stay and from there there is tons to do within a 20 mile radius.
We loved our stay at Anna's home and recommend it highly.

name: Kat
review: We stayed at Anna's place as it was close to an activity we had scheduled. The house was comfortable, and most items were new and clean as she described. However, the pictures in the listing were different from the listing & need updating to reflect current condition. The entire bed set is different which is fine, but there were no lamps on the bed tables as I expected. The gazebo shade structure shown on the deck is not there. I think maintenance was warranted before our arrival-there were cobwebs on the decking and in the sauna. It seemed many light switches did not control anything; the lights on the front & back porches did not work as far as I know. The lack of pots for cooking was problematic; there was only 1 small saucepan. We've stayed at numerous homes with Airbnb as comparison, so I think this home is just new to renting & could be a real gem with a little TLC, especially curb appeal.  We liked the location on the water, and the value was definitely there for our short stay.

name: Insi
review:
Wanted to have a vacation that’s as quiet and peaceful with a nice deck looking at the water. 
Neighbors were super nice and it felt like we are right at home. 
Enjoyed our stay and much needed R&R. Anna was a great host and super helpful. 
Thank for having us stay at your place with our furbabies.

name: Charles
review: Firstly, the pictures on the website don't do justice, this is a lovingly maintained family getaway with brand new bamboo flooring, new towels and linens and all the comforts of our own home. Everything in the house was immaculate. Easy to find, in a quiet neighborhood but with shops and facilities including boat launch 2 minutes away. We kept our boat in the water at the dock off the expansive wooden deck in the back yard. The fishing on the lake was amazing, the bass at Clearlake are overfed, overstuffed drag-burning monsters. We also did some horseback riding, gold panning (no luck) on a couple of icy-cold streams, spent a day at the nearby state park and visited some wineries in Napa county just up the road about 45 minutes away. It was a great stay we wished we could have stayed longer. Anna was a wonderful hostess (thanks for the wine!) who answered all our questions quickly and helped our family vacation to Clearlake be a total success.
